title: DarkXZombies
features:
DarkXZombies | Michael's Zombies Cheat

Silent aim with wallbang — shoot through any wall directly at zombie heads. Every bullet hits the target, no matter what's in the way.

ESP shows all zombies on your screen — boxes, health bars, names with distance, and tracers pointing from the bottom of your screen to every zombie nearby.

Rapid fire 

Anti-kick keeps you connected 

RightShift toggles the menu. 

ESP colors: Red, Green, Blue, White, Yellow — pick what looks best on your screen.

Target part: Head for max damage, HumanoidRootPart for consistent hits, UpperTorso for easy aim.

FOV circle shows your aim radius on screen. Adjustable size from 50 to 1000.

Everything is server-validated friendly — silent aim hooks the actual fire function, wallbang hooks the raycast, rapid fire modifies gun settings before the server sees them.
